evals.prompt:
Write the specification for this request: "Let support agents merge duplicate customer accounts."

Decisions already made: agents with the support-lead role can merge; a merge keeps the older account and moves orders, addresses, and notes to it; the newer account is closed, not deleted, and keeps a pointer to the one it merged into; merges can be undone within 30 days; accounts with an open dispute cannot be merged; bulk merging is out of scope for now. A merge of an account with up to 1,000 orders must finish within 5 seconds.

Answer with only one fenced markdown block containing the specification.
evals.expected_output: A specification with the need, scope, non-goals including bulk merges, numbered requirements including the 5-second target and the dispute rule, and Given/When/Then criteria covering every requirement, including the undo window and the role check.
assertions: Every requirement is covered by a Given/When/Then criterion
Covers the failure cases: open dispute, wrong role, undo after 30 days
